theory.title: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto
theory.explanation: Usa ask o tell + persona + to + infinitivo para transmitir peticiones y órdenes: Please send a receipt pasa a She asked me to send a receipt (me pidió que enviara un recibo). Usa not to para las peticiones negativas.
theory.tip: Ask/tell + persona + to + infinitivo. Para prohibiciones: not to + infinitivo.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 1
patterns.pattern: The customer asked me to check the order.
examples:
The customer asked me to check the order.
→ El cliente me pidió que comprobara el pedido.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 2
patterns.pattern: The manager told us to contact the supplier.
examples:
The manager told us to contact the supplier.
→ El gerente nos dijo que contactáramos con el proveedor.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 3
patterns.pattern: She asked him not to cancel the payment.
examples:
She asked him not to cancel the payment.
→ Ella le pidió que no cancelara el pago.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 4
patterns.pattern: They told the assistant to send a refund.
examples:
They told the assistant to send a refund.
→ Dijeron al asistente que enviara un reembolso.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 5
patterns.pattern: I asked the shop to replace the faulty item.
examples:
I asked the shop to replace the faulty item.
→ Pedí a la tienda que sustituyera el artículo defectuoso.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 6
patterns.pattern: The supervisor told everyone to keep the receipt.
examples:
The supervisor told everyone to keep the receipt.
→ El supervisor dijo a todos que guardaran el recibo.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 7
patterns.pattern: He asked me to explain the warranty.
examples:
He asked me to explain the warranty.
→ Él me pidió que explicara la garantía.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 8
patterns.pattern: They told us not to open the package.
examples:
They told us not to open the package.
→ Nos dijeron que no abriéramos el paquete.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 9
patterns.pattern: The customer asked the company to deliver it again.
examples:
The customer asked the company to deliver it again.
→ El cliente pidió a la empresa que lo entregara de nuevo.

patterns.label: Peticiones y órdenes en estilo indirecto · 10
patterns.pattern: The manager told me to reply before Friday.
examples:
The manager told me to reply before Friday.
→ El gerente me dijo que respondiera antes del viernes.

content.passage: A customer contacted a shop because a new phone had arrived damaged. The assistant asked her to send a photograph and told her to keep the receipt. The customer asked the shop to replace the phone, but the manager explained that the supplier needed to inspect it first. He told the team not to close the complaint until the replacement had been delivered. The customer was pleased that the company responded quickly.

items.prompt: Report a request a customer might make about a damaged product.
items.modelAnswer: A customer might ask for a replacement because the headphones arrived with a damaged cable. They could say, 'Could you please replace this item or arrange a refund? I have the receipt and the original packaging.'

items.prompt: Explain what a manager told staff to do.
items.modelAnswer: The manager told the staff to check every order before it left the warehouse. She asked them to confirm the address and make sure the correct item was packed. This was important because several parcels had been sent to the wrong customers.

items.prompt: Describe a time you asked a company to solve a problem.
items.modelAnswer: I once contacted an online shop because a kettle stopped working after only two days. I explained the problem, sent a photograph and asked what they could do. They arranged a free replacement, which arrived the following week.

items.prompt: Report a request using asked me not to.
items.modelAnswer: The shop assistant asked me not to remove the security label until I had decided to keep the jacket. She explained that the label helped the store process returns. I followed her advice and kept the receipt.

items.prompt: What might a shop assistant tell a customer to keep?
items.modelAnswer: A shop assistant might tell a customer to keep the receipt, the warranty and the product's original packaging. These details can be useful if the item needs to be repaired or returned.

items.prompt: Explain how to report a complaint politely.
items.modelAnswer: I would explain the problem calmly, give the order number and describe what outcome I would prefer. I would avoid blaming the person who answers the phone because they may not be responsible for the mistake.

items.prompt: Describe a request you made about a delivery.
items.modelAnswer: I asked the delivery company to leave my parcel with a neighbour because I would be at work. I gave the neighbour's address and checked that someone would be home. The parcel arrived safely.

items.prompt: Report instructions given before a refund.
items.modelAnswer: Before a refund, the staff told me to return the product with its receipt and complete a short form. They explained how long the refund would take and asked me to keep the confirmation email.

items.prompt: Talk about a time someone asked you to change something.
items.modelAnswer: A colleague asked me to change the colour of a poster because the original design was difficult to read. I agreed and chose a darker colour with larger letters. The final version was much clearer.

items.prompt: Give three reported requests using ask or tell.
items.modelAnswer: The customer asked the shop to replace the faulty charger. The manager told the team to check the stock. The delivery company asked me not to leave the parcel outside. These are examples of reported requests.

content.audioTranscript: A: I'm calling about my order. B: Do you have the receipt? A: Yes. The customer service told me I could get a refund. B: Was there a problem with the delivery? A: Yes, so I asked to speak to the manager. B: I'll contact the supplier and check the payment. A: Thank you. Is the parcel going to the right address? B: Yes, it should arrive tomorrow.
